newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Around 4,938 phone lines are still out of order in Jeddah after heavy rains which lashed the kingdom last week.
- Saudi investment group to undertake new tourism projects worth 40 million riyals in Medina.
- Arab National Bank posted a net profit of 390 million riyals in the first 10 months of 1996. The bank will raise its paid-in capital to 1.5 billion riyals by granting bonus shares to shareholders.
